about: Rules for the held-ground simulation (scripts/compile-front.ts). Gates: a side can take ground in a territory only from the event that opens that front. Anchored: in these territories a side's held ground is a band reaching in from its own border (a siege front tied to its homeland) rather than an area around its army. Each rule names its basis.

gates.basis: The Imperial Army has crossed the Tempest border (V13 Ch1). Before it, the column is inside the Empire and holds no Jura ground, whatever the reach of its numbers.

anchored.basis: The Dwargon front is a siege from the imperial side of the border: the Composite Division and later the Legion press on Dwargon's eastern gate and metropolis from the Empire, supplied across that border (V13, V15). The text gives no line of control, so the held ground is drawn as a band from the imperial border, coast to the Tempest border, as deep as the imperial formations stand. RECONSTRUCTED.
